description: This header defines optimized non-temporal memory copy functions using SIMD instructions (SSE, AVX, ARM intrinsics) for efficient large memory block copying, with platform-specific includes and conditional implementations.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using SIMD instructions, optimized for aligned and unaligned addresses, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy_avx
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using AVX instructions, optimized for large blocks and aligned addresses.
